set -euo pipefail
CACHE_DIR="/work/notes-api-cache"
EXPECTED="/work/notes-api-cache"
if [ ! -e "$CACHE_DIR" ]; then
  echo "Cache directory does not exist: $CACHE_DIR"
  exit 0
fi
REAL="$(realpath "$CACHE_DIR")"
if [ "$REAL" != "$EXPECTED" ]; then
  echo "Refusing to remove unexpected path: $REAL"
  exit 1
fi
printf 'Before removal:\n'
du -sh "$CACHE_DIR"
rm -rf -- "$CACHE_DIR"
printf '\nAfter removal check:\n'
if [ -e "$CACHE_DIR" ]; then
  echo "Removal failed; path still exists: $CACHE_DIR"
…
